The '''ILC-905 system''' was located in the [[Koornacht Cluster/Legends|Koornacht Cluster]] on the edge of the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]]. It contained a single star orbited by 12 planets, with an [[Asteroid field/Legends|asteroid belt]] separating the outermost rocky planet from the innermost [[Gas giant/Legends|gas giant]].

==History==
In [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]] a [[Type II Orbital Repair Yard]] formerly assigned to the [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial Navy's]] [[Sixth Negative Regions|Black Sword Command]] was moved to the [[Gas giant/Legends|gas giant]] world of [[Prildaz]] located in this system after it had been captured by [[Yevetha]]ns who were rebelling against the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Empire]].

Some [[16 ABY/Legends|twelve years later]] the shipyard and its defending [[Aramadia-class thrustship|thrustships]], in response to the genocidal [[Yevethan Purge]], was destroyed by a squadron led by [[Commodore/Legends|Commodore]] [[Turk Brand|Brand]] aboard the cruiser [[Indomitable (Majestic-class)|''Indomitable'']] in the [[Battle of ILC-905]].

==Behind the scenes==
In [[Cracken's Threat Dossier]] it appears as '''ICL-905'''.
